newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schmalbach-Lubeca aims for profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Schmalbach-Lubeca aims for profit growth.

text.p: German packaging group Schmalbach-Lubeca AG is aiming to achieve double-digit growth in group profit this year, the Viag unit's management board chairman said on Thursday.
Adjusted for extraordinary earnings, Schmalbach group net profit in 1997 would be "more than 10 percent higher than in 1996", chairman Hanno Fiedler told shareholders in Duesseldorf.
The company had net profit of 51 million marks in 1996.
Fiedler forecast sales would fall slightly to four billion marks from 4.1 billion this year. He said sales from January to May rose five percent to 1.85 billion marks.
By the year 2000 the company aimed to generate group sales of around five billion marks.
